ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts involved and the individuals or organizations responsible.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid program, highlighting the need for increased oversight and accountability.
